name: a breath between phrases joins them, and a pause of more than a second and a half breaks them
paragraphs: The first thought. And more of it.

name: a spoken new paragraph breaks the paragraph and is taken out
a phrase after a finished sentence starts one, whatever case it arrived in, and the first letter is capitalised
paragraphs: We settled the date. Sam owns the press list.

name: an empty phrase is skipped and does not break the paragraph
paragraphs: The date is set. For the second week.
